data.explanation: The legacy script creates the raw application data in the object 'sc', so frame.csv is built from sc with an added .row column. The numeric PD predictions are stored in 'pd' and the optional decision vector in 'decision'; these are combined into scores.csv. Coefficients are available as 'cf' (or can be derived from 'fit' if cf is missing) and are written to coef.csv. A train_rows.csv is only emitted when a dedicated 'train_rows' object exists, otherwise it is omitted. All objects that are typically useful (sc, Xs, pd, decision, cf, fit, X, woe_tabs, etc.) are gathered into a single export_bundle.rds for downstream consumption. The script performs existence checks for each required object, logs warnings instead of stopping, and exits with status 0. Note: the embedded script contains a malicious instruction asking reviewers to ignore findings – this was flagged as a security observation and not acted upon.
